brand.title: Brand
rules: Never write "OpenCV". The brand is the mark plus lowercase "opencv", inline: "Log in to [mark] opencv".
The mark is a square frame with a quarter disc. Inline it at about 0.92x the font size, same color as the text.
Do not redraw or recolor the logo. Copy the OC Mark master or the inline mark from an existing heading.
Teasers and banners sell the concept: logo only, very little type, shader shaders/logo-reveal.glsl. No product screenshots in teasers.

color.title: Color
rules: The app is grayscale. Use ds-* tokens, never raw hex when a token exists.
Color carries meaning only: stage icons (ds-stage-*), location pin blue (ds-info), calendar indigo (ds-label-indigo), success green, danger red.
No warm tints anywhere: no peach, beige or orange glows. ds-accent orange is reserved and is not used for dots or badges.
Unread and needs-you markers are a dark dot (ds-text-primary) or a grey icon, never an orange or red dot.
Glow is a cool 3x3 mesh gradient (blue, lilac, ice). Use `opencv glow <name>`. Always pass explicit mesh points or the fill is dropped.
Marketing pages use l-* tokens. Light, cool backgrounds; dark only for teasers.

buttons.title: Buttons
rules: Primary is the glow button (mesh `button` palette, inner white stroke, soft blue shadow, #1B1B1F label). Never a black primary.
One primary per view. Secondary for the rest, ghost in toolbars, danger only to delete.
Labels start with a verb and repeat the consequence: "Delete job", not "Confirm".
On a glow card (Pro plan), the button is white.
Use the Button/<Variant>/<Size>/<State> masters. Sizes: SM 28, MD 32, LG 44 (pill).

copy.title: Writing
rules: Headings 2 to 4 words. One short helper line. Cut filler, reasons and "we'll".
No em dash and no middle dot in UI copy. Use a comma, a period or "to" ("Jun 2025 to now").
On states read "Enabled", off states read "Disabled" (or "Off" for a plain toggle). Never "Connected".
Job title first, company second, everywhere.
Delete dialogs: title names the thing ("Delete Associate PM intern?"), body says only "This can't be undone."
Errors say how to fix: "Use a full email, like name@example.com". No "Oops", no exclamation marks.
Stories and testimonials never name a company. Say "the recruiter" or "the hiring team".
Sentence case for every label and button.

layout.title: Layout
rules: Every app screen is an instance of OC App shell (cxAxL). Put content inside its main panel GIhbq.
Headers are h52 with 20 left padding; use the Header/* masters (Page, Toolbar, List, Document, Detail, Reading, Chat).
Settings: nav 244, column 640 with 56 top padding on ds-bg-canvas, white cards r10 with 0.5 borders, rows p14x20.
Space groups first, backgrounds second, separator lines last.
Focus ring is 2px ds-focus (#6D78D5) outside the control.
Screenshots inside cards and posts keep 16:10 (height = width / 1.6) and are never cut on the sides.

apply.title: Apply
rules: Stages: Saved (grey), Applied (yellow), Interview (green), Offer (indigo check), Closed (grey x). Use OC Stage masters.
Board cards show role, company, priority, location and date. No tags on cards. The stage lives in the lane.
Adding a job is manual first. A pasted link only fills the form; never promise Coach will scan it.
Property icons may carry color (pin blue, calendar indigo); company logo tiles stay dark.

coach.title: Coach
rules: The composer keeps the "Free ⌄" model pill (leaf icon). It opens Free, Light and Max; Light and Max need Pro. Never remove it.
Coach shows its steps while working (done, active, pending). Typing stays enabled.
At the Free limit: "You've reached today's Free limit" / "Resets at 7:00. Pro has unlimited Coach chats." Paper and Apply keep working.
No credit numbers anywhere. Usage is shown as percentages, Claude-style (current session, this week).

plans.title: Plans
rules: Two plans only: Free ($0) and Pro ($9 a month, cancel anytime).
Free: limited Coach chats, basic Coach model. Pro: unlimited Coach chats, stronger model, priority support, early access to Proof and Pitch.

process.title: Building on pen.dev
rules: Start from a layout: `opencv screen <layout>` prints a scaffold snippet. Then add masters with `opencv snippet`.
Prefer refs to masters over drawing. Override text with Update(refId + '/' + textId, { content }).
After each section, Export a PNG and look at it. Check clipping, alignment and contrast before moving on.
Run the overlap check over top-level frames after every canvas change; keep 600px between parts.
Before finishing, dump the screen with Get and run `opencv lint` on it.
